description: Generate a Higgsfield video from a prompt. Prefers the customer's connected Higgsfield MCP account login and subscription credits; api_key is only the Cloud API fallback.

api_key.description: Optional Higgsfield Cloud API key for this call. Omit it to use the connected Higgsfield MCP account login when available.

model.description: Optional Higgsfield model id when using the MCP account path

negative_prompt.description: What to avoid in the video

prompt.description: Text description of the video to generate

style.description: Soul Style name (use higgsfield_get_styles to list available styles)

name: higgsfield_generate_video
